table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AliasName = NULL,
	SupplierName=S.BankAcc,
	NetAmount=SUM(ISNULL(P.InvTotal, 0)),
	TaxCategory = TC.Name,
	AdvanceTaxPerc = MAX(TC.TaxPerc),
	AdvanceTaxAmt = SUM(P.AdvanceTaxAmt)
FROM
	PurLedger P, Accounts A, Supplier S, TaxCategory TC
WHERE
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND
	P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	P.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode) AND
	P.SuppCode = S.SuppCode AND
	P.TaxCategoryCode = TC.TaxCategoryCode AND
	S.SuppCode = A.AccCode 
GROUP BY 
	TC.Name,
	S.BankAcc
